attrs.text: **Git updates only** — Discover updates only a bundle installed from a Git commit. For a bundle installed from a registry, **Update available** opens its Installed page, whose Versions section updates it from the registry. For any other bundle with a newer index version, including a Git copy whose newer versions come from npm, another repository, or are incompatible, **Update available** opens an Installed page that offers no update; uninstall it and install it again.

title: **Automatic selection reads only the deployment composition** — a menu offers it when the composition layer sets no provider for that capability. While automatic selection applies, the Host's `DSH_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER` or `DSH_WEB_FETCH_PROV...

attrs.text: **Automatic selection reads only the deployment composition** — a menu offers it when the composition layer sets no provider for that capability. While automatic selection applies, the Host's `DSH_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER` or `DSH_WEB_FETCH_PROVIDER` environment variable picks the provider instead, and the page does not show that choice. Without either, automatic Fetch selection with more than one usable registered provider makes each operation fail with `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS`, and so does automatic Search selection when the Host does not register the DeepSeek provider it prefers for the conversation's model. The line under automatic Search selection is fixed copy that describes the Host with both DeepSeek search providers registered.

An unavailable billing withholds the web tool from the model.

Chip visuals derive from the lexicon scan; no occurrence identity, position tracking, or structured reference payload exists on the prompt wire.

attrs.text: **Catalog changes without a forwarded event keep cached catalogs** — an HMR reload after a CLI or hand edit announces no `plugin-manager/changed` event, and adding or removing a `SKILL.md` on disk forwards no event at all, so an open session lists its previous skills until a preset switch, plugin manager operation, or connection reset.

title: **Draft skill highlighting waits for the next catalog fetch** — a preset switch, plugin manager operation, or connection reset empties the session's lexicon, so with the menu closed an existing `/name` in the draft loses its skill highlight...

attrs.text: **Draft skill highlighting waits for the next catalog fetch** — a preset switch, plugin manager operation, or connection reset empties the session's lexicon, so with the menu closed an existing `/name` in the draft loses its skill highlight until the `/` menu fetches the catalog again; an open menu fetches it immediately.
